sql: SELECT * FROM ((SELECT 1 AS g, o.created_at::text AS t, coalesce(o.strategy,'-') AS b, o.market_ticker AS c, coalesce(o.side,'-') AS d, o.limit_price::text AS e, coalesce(o.status,'-') AS f FROM live_orders o WHERE o.created_at > now() - interval '5 hours' ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT 8) UNION ALL (SELECT 2 AS g, max(at)::text, 'evt', kind, count(*)::text, '-', '-' FROM incentive_collector_events WHERE at > now() - interval '3 hours' GROUP BY kind ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 10) UNION ALL (SELECT 3 AS g, p.captured_at::text, 'pos', p.market_ticker, coalesce(p.side,'-'), p.quantity::text, coalesce(p.realized_pnl::text,'-') FROM positions p WHERE p.captured_at > now() - interval '15 minutes' ORDER BY p.captured_at DESC LIMIT 8)) u ORDER BY g, t DESC
